item.title: Final Fantasy 14 Players Deliver Perfect Response to 2026’s PHP Vulnerability
item.description: A number of major websites and services went offline earlier this week thanks to a massive PHP security vulnerability . One such service was Final Fantasy 14 . That posed a major problem for plants. You see, Square Enix's MMO has a number of systems on real-world timers that continue regardless of whether a player is logged in. Those unlucky enough to be locked out of the game during the PHP issue were left fearing that their gardens would wither and die. Thankfully, the community stepped in.

item.title: 7 Hilarious ‘Far Side’ Comics With the Worst Puns
item.description: One of the best possible recipes for comedy is to have incredibly dumb characters written by incredibly smart people. Homer Simpson, for example, has often been written by Harvard-educated writers staffed at The Simpsons . Fry on Futurama is the same kind of character, as is Michael Scott from The Office , and basically every character on It’s Always Sunny in Philadelphia .

item.title: 12 Years Ago, 'Doctor Who's Most Unhinged Episode Revealed the Doctor at His Worst
item.description: Doctor Who has never shied away from showing the Doctor at his worst . In “A Good Man Goes to War,” Eleven (Matt Smith) realizes that his choices have made him nearly as monstrous as his enemies. In “The Waters of Mars,” Ten (David Tennant) is still reeling from the loss of his most recent companion, Donna Noble (Catherine Tate), and determined to win for once. He uses his power over time to save people whose deaths are fixed points in history, consequences be damned. It’s a genuinely shocking, villainous moment for the Time Lord.

item.title: 50 Years Later, the Best War Series of All Time Is Still Unlike Anything Else on TV
item.description: When Robert Altman's M*A*S*H arrived in theaters in 1970, its irreverent approach to the Korean War was unlike anything audiences had seen before. The film followed army surgeons who used practical jokes, alcohol, and a disregard for military authority to maintain their sanity while treating the wounded. Two years later, CBS adapted the film into a television series that retained its anarchic spirit but accomplished something the movie couldn't: It gave audiences time to get to know these characters.

item.title: J.J. Abrams’ Best Original Sci-Fi Movie Officially Finds a New Home on Streaming
item.description: In early 2006, J.J. Abrams was in the midst of a generational run. Alias was about to end, Lost had become a cultural phenomenon, and Abrams was traveling the world promoting his directorial debut with Mission: Impossible 3 . Somehow, Abrams was just getting started.

item.title: The Witcher's Geralt Officially Returns for New Adventure
item.description: The Witcher fans have had a lot to look forward to, like a remaster of The Witcher 3 , the Songs of the Past expansion , and The Witcher 4 , expected sometime in 2028 . Those fans probably know by now that their favorite monster-hunting games are based on an iconic book series (as is the Netflix show ), and they'll be glad to learn that author Andrzej Sapkowski has more up his sleeve.

item.title: Disney's Officially Bringing Back a '90s Cartoon Icon After 35 Years
item.description: Disney is apparently still rummaging around in its animation vault, and this time it’s pulled out a duck who has spent the last 35 years waiting for another chance to fight a bunch of extremely ridiculous villains. Darkwing Duck is officially returning in a brand-new series for Disney Plus, Disney has confirmed.

item.title: 7 Classic JRPGs That Are So Good They Never Need a Remake
item.description: Remakes, remasters, and reimaginings are all the rage right now in video games. For the last several years, studios the world over have crafted new and vastly improved versions of all-time classic games, ranging from faithful modernizations like Capcom’s Resident Evil 4 remake to Square Enix’s wildly ambitious and expanded Final Fantasy 7 Remake trilogy . While plenty of older games benefit from a modern glow-up, others don’t need a lot of alterations to shine bright decades later.

item.title: Every Marvel Post-Credits Scene That Went Nowhere (So Far)
item.description: Once the Infinity Saga wrapped with 2019’s Spider-Man: Far From Home , Marvel had to find a new central organizing factor, a way to give all the crossovers , cataclysmic conflicts , and multiverse mayhem some meaning. That process has been bumpy , and it’s left Marvel with a lot of loose ends, hints, and promises of sagas to come, which have become difficult to keep track of.

item.title: An '80s Cult Horror-Comedy Becomes a Global Streaming Hit on HBO Max
item.description: There was a time when horror movies weren't afraid to get a little weird. The 1980s gave us everything from the surreal nightmares of A Nightmare on Elm Street to the gooey, creature-filled chaos of The Blob . It was an era when filmmakers could mix practical-effects gore, genuinely unsettling monsters, and a healthy dose of absurdity without worrying too much about fitting into a single genre.
